instruction.text: Read the text and solve the problem.

atoms.a: The population of the UK is around <mat>68000000</mat>. About <mat>20400000</mat> people are under the age of 30. What percentage of the UK population is under 30?
In Katie’s village there are <mat>3255</mat> people. <mat>651</mat> of them are over 1.80 metres tall. What percentage of people in Katie’s village are over 1.80 metres tall?
In the woodlands near Craig’s house there are lots of wild animals. There are 3 foxes, 12 badgers and 35 moles. Work out what percentage each species makes up.
atoms.b:
6% are foxes
24% are badgers
70% are moles

atoms.a: 498 people from a village of 1,245 went to the local market. What percentage of the village did not go to the local market?

In an orchestra, there are 2 conductors, 2 violinists, 3 cellists, 5 trumpeters and 4 trombonists. What percentage of the orchestra doesn’t play an instrument, and what percentage of the orchestra play the trumpet?
